gloss: instantly; in no time; at once

definitions.gloss: instantly; in no time; at once
definitions.explanation: Describes something happening very quickly or immediately, often with a sense of surprising speed.

examples.japanese: たちまち{人気|にんき}が{出|で}た。
examples.english: It became popular in no time.

examples.japanese: {空|そら}がたちまち{暗|くら}くなった。
{噂|うわさ}はたちまち{町中|まちじゅう}に{広|ひろ}まった。
examples.english: The rumor spread throughout the town in no time.

notes:
KANJI:
Can be written as {忽|たちま}ち, though hiragana is more common.

USAGE:
たちまち emphasizes the surprising speed at which something happens. It often describes changes, spread of information, or completion of actions that occur faster than expected.

COMMON PATTERNS:
・たちまち〜になる (to instantly become ~)
・たちまち{広|ひろ}まる (to spread in no time)
・たちまちのうちに (in the blink of an eye)

REGISTER:
Neutral to slightly literary. Used in both spoken and written Japanese.

SIMILAR WORDS:
・すぐに - immediately (neutral, most common)
・あっという{間|ま}に - in the blink of an eye
・{瞬|またた}く{間|ま}に - in an instant (literary)
・{即座|そくざ}に - immediately (formal)
